source.description: The first candidate transfer supplied the export core and compiled frontend. These are not phase-two or final packaged reruns.

generatorPreparation: The verification generator used a Windows fileURL conversion fix, later included in phase two. Export core and frontend remained the first candidate transfer.
sanitization: Research paths, titles, source file inventories, document content and screenshots are excluded. Only counts, software verification results and receipt hashes are retained.
limits: The table and chart edits were explicitly verified after reopen. Group and mathematical object retention were verified; this receipt does not claim a separate interactive edit of every group or formula.
